name: bifrost-cost-race
description: Test 3 on Bifrost transports/v2.2.6, run through run-cost.sh with a throwaway key (limits in the run's NOTE.md and quota.json). A $0.0001 budget (about 3 Claude requests) and ten requests at once. With no reservation, every request that starts before any usage is charged should be admitted: expect the burst to overshoot the budget, and the next burst refused.
